messages:
Renee Kim: hey everyone — Renee here! joined Growth Eng today, remote SF. usually online 8:3017:30 PT. love spicy food, folding bikes, and badly timed puns :bike::hot_pepper:
Sam Booker: welcome Renee!! if youre coming by the office, badge pickup is at People Ops (floor 1) after 10am. say youre with Growth Eng and theyll sort you out :idcard:
Lina Gomez: hi Renee, welcome!! we usually do a quick rooftop meet at 4:30 on Fridays for snacks and bad memes. also theres a tiny herb planter by the kitchen you can repot something into :herb::sunny:
Renee Kim: love rooftop snacks — count me in for Friday. also: where do people stash their spare charger cables? mine are always nomadic :plug:
Eli Navarro: theres a labeled box in the supply closet "cables + chargers" — help yourself. also note: the midday coffee queue is long on Tuesdays, pro tip: bring a travel mug and hit the espresso at 10:45 :coffee:
Sam Booker: quick lunch poll: dumplings on 4th or pizza from Slice Corner? vote with emoji ":dumplings:" or ":pizza:"
Lina Gomez: :dumplings: for me — extra chili oil please
Renee Kim: :dumplings: spicy please, and an extra napkin for my napkin-less eating habits
onboarding-bot: Welcome Renee! A buddy (Sam Booker) has been assigned and a calendar "New Hire Welcome" event is scheduled at 11:15. Check your DMs for onboarding docs. :robot_face:
Renee Kim: got the calendar invite, thanks bot! also logged into the wifi but had to use the guest key. is there a secure wifi password somewhere?
Eli Navarro: secure wifi is on 802.1X (use SSO). if you need a quick guide: ```SSID: Redwood-Staff
Connect method: SSO > login with company email > accept cert
If stuck ping infra-oncall or DM me.```
Sam Booker: FYI theres a little shelf near the 2nd-floor window labeled "unclaimed snacks". if you find mystery cookies, thats probably me :cookie::eyes:
Lina Gomez: Renee, drop a note in #growth when youre ready for your first pairing session — Sam and I usually do a 1hr setup walkthrough the first week
Renee Kim: will do, thanks yall! excited to be here :smile:
